# PaneCrew

> PaneCrew is a free, open-source (MIT) VS Code extension that runs multiple real,
> simultaneously visible terminal sessions in one grid across a multi-root workspace, paired
> with a sidebar explorer that automatically follows whichever pane currently has focus.
> Tool-agnostic: hosts any CLI coding agent — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or a plain shell — <!-- brandlint-ok: functional list of supported CLI tools, matches README/homepage wording -->
> equally well.

- [Homepage](https://panecrew.dev/): product overview, feature grid, install instructions
- [How to Run Multiple CLI Coding Agent Sessions](https://panecrew.dev/guides/multiple-cli-agent-sessions/): guide + FAQ on running Claude Code/Codex/Gemini CLI in parallel <!-- brandlint-ok: functional list of supported CLI tools, matches the guide page's own copy -->
- [How to Open Multiple Terminal Windows](https://panecrew.dev/guides/multiple-terminal-windows/): guide + FAQ on running independent PaneCrew workspace windows side by side
- [How Many Claude Code Sessions to Run at Once](https://panecrew.dev/guides/how-many-claude-code-sessions/): guide + FAQ on the practical ceiling for simultaneously visible Claude Code sessions <!-- brandlint-ok: functional guide title/summary, matches the guide page's own copy -->
- [How to Prevent Multiple Coding Agents From Editing the Same Files](https://panecrew.dev/guides/prevent-agents-editing-same-files/): guide + FAQ on avoiding file conflicts between parallel agent sessions via separate directories, Git worktrees, and per-pane isolation
